# IslaTrade — The Philippines' B2B Marketplace

> Alibaba-grade B2B marketplace for the Philippines: source from verified Filipino suppliers across 8 industries, compare product listings with PHP pricing and minimum orders, and post Requests for Quotation (RFQs) free. Built by Mark1 Automation; production app at islatrade.onrender.com (deploy pending), this mirror holds the public catalog.

IslaTrade connects international buyers with Philippine manufacturers, growers, and makers. Products carry export-grade detail (pricing tiers, minimum order quantities, supplier attribution). Suppliers are verified across electronics, furniture, food & agriculture, textiles, construction, machinery, health & wellness, and packaging. Buyers post RFQs free; suppliers register to list products. This static mirror exposes the full public catalog: home, product categories, individual product pages, and supplier profiles. Account/login/register/admin routes are application-only and not part of the public catalog. The live transactional app (RFQ submission, accounts) ships at islatrade.onrender.com.

## Catalog sections

- [Home](https://mark-automation.github.io/islatrade/): overview, industry tiles, featured products
- [All products](https://mark-automation.github.io/islatrade/products/): full searchable product listing
- [Suppliers](https://mark-automation.github.io/islatrade/suppliers/): directory of verified Filipino suppliers
- [Post RFQ](https://mark-automation.github.io/islatrade/rfq/): request-for-quotation explainer (submission in live app)

## Notes

- Full machine-readable URL list: [sitemap.xml](https://mark-automation.github.io/islatrade/sitemap.xml) (product pages under /product/, supplier profiles under /supplier/)
- Pricing is in Philippine pesos (₱); each product page states price range, minimum order, and supplying company
